title: Vertex-fixed simplicial homotopies give coherent equivalences of precomposition functors
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets, quasicategories and coherent natural equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $X,Y$ be small simplicial sets, let $a,b:X\to Y$ be simplicial maps, and let $H:X\times\Delta^1\to Y$ satisfy $H|_{X\times\{0\}}=a$ and $H|_{X\times\{1\}}=b$. Assume that for every vertex $x$ of $X$, the edge $H|_{\{x\}\times\Delta^1}$ is degenerate. For every quasicategory $\mathcal E$ in a sufficiently large containing universe, put $D=\operatorname{Fun}(Y,\mathcal E)$ and $T=\operatorname{Fun}(X,\mathcal E)$. The simplicial map
$$\Phi_H:D\times\Delta^1\longrightarrow T$$
adjoint to the composite
$$X\times D\times\Delta^1\longrightarrow Y\times D\longrightarrow\mathcal E,\qquad(x,f,u)\longmapsto(H(x,u),f)\longmapsto f(H(x,u)),$$
where the last arrow is internal-Hom evaluation, is a coherent natural equivalence $a^*\simeq b^*$: its adjoint edge in $\operatorname{Fun}(D,T)$ is an equivalence edge. Here $a^*,b^*:D\to T$ are precomposition with $a,b$, respectively. Neither $X$ nor $Y$ is required to be a quasicategory or nonempty; all iterated functor simplicial sets are formed in a common containing universe.

from.place: Historical master proof, paragraph beginning “For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$”, sentence “use the reduction of integral compact supports ... and derived coefficient adjunction to compute”: inherited coherent-diagram foundation through the finite-adjunction realization, semilinear sections, flat model, pointed model, finite-shape generation, final-index colimit, and anodyne-cocones chain. The fixed-target arrow lifting argument is a supporting lemma from Kerodon, not a statement or proof explicitly present in that blueprint paragraph. The current main-20261015 statement at sec-six-functors/sk-thm-sf-package has a separate prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint.proof.md with the same paragraph beginning For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$. This node supplies the blunt-join extension input to the fixed-target arrow lifting argument. Specifically, the simplex case of the supporting blunt-cone comparison, returned proof step 4: converting the vertex-fixed homotopy into a coherent natural equivalence of precomposition functors.
